description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods, On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT, with respect to temperature, comparing their accuracy. The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, measured as Pass@8, with a linear scale, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is depicted in orange with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 62.5 at a temperature of 0.1, peaking at approximately 75.0 at 0.6, and ending at around 72.5 at 1.0, with fluctuations in between. The LUFFY line is shown in red with star markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 75.0 at 0.1, generally staying above 75.0 across the temperature range, and ending at approximately 80.0 at 1.0. The SFT line is represented in blue with no markers and a solid line style, starting at around 75.0 at 0.1, decreasing to approximately 68.0 at 0.7, and then increasing to around 73.0 at 1.0.
